content: Architected and established a scalable {{Flutter monorepo}}, enabling shared code, modular architecture, and streamlined development across {{5 production mobile applications}}.

Designed and implemented {{CI/CD pipelines}} using GitHub Actions and Fastlane, automating build, code signing, testing, and deployment to Google Play and the App Store, {{reducing manual release effort by 80%}}.
Established a comprehensive testing strategy with {{unit, widget, golden, and integration tests}} to improve quality, reliability, and regression coverage.
Integrated {{Firebase Analytics, Cloud Messaging and Remote Config}} to support user engagement, feature flagging, staged rollouts, and data-driven product decisions.
Developed reusable {{Claude AI skills}} for Dart and Flutter workflows, improving developer productivity through AI-assisted code generation, project standards, and engineering best practices.
Led development of cross-platform applications using {{Flutter}} and {{Next.js}}, ensuring scalability and maintainability.
Built high-performance, responsive UI for both {{mobile and web}} platforms.
Implemented {{clean architecture}} and modular component systems, improving code maintainability.
Integrated the frontend with {{REST APIs}} and backend services, ensuring seamless data flow.
{{Mentored developers}} and conducted code reviews, improving overall code quality.
Led frontend development using {{Flutter, React.js, and React Native}} for cross-platform applications.
Integrated applications with {{REST APIs}} and backend {{microservices}}.
Developed backend services using {{Laravel}}, supporting frontend integration.
Developed scalable mobile applications using {{Flutter (Dart)}}.
Built and maintained {{reusable UI components and libraries}}, accelerating feature delivery.
Implemented {{CI/CD pipelines}} using GitHub Actions and Fastlane, streamlining deployment processes.
Applied state management ({{Bloc, Riverpod}}) for scalable application architecture.
Developed {{Flutter}} mobile applications and {{React.js}} web applications.
Integrated {{REST APIs}} and improved application reliability.
Collaborated using {{Git-based workflows}} and code reviews.
